english.note: Use this when the amazement is sudden or shocking, with a sense of startling the person.

exampleSentences.english: That sudden bang can amaze me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰一下巨響可以嚇親我。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 jat1 haa5 geoi6 hoeng2 ho2 ji5 haak3 can1 ngo5

english.note: Use this colloquial form when the astonishment is sudden or shocking and may suggest being startled or frightened.

exampleSentences.english: You suddenly stood behind me—you really did astonish me!
exampleSentences.traditional: 你突然企喺我後面，真係嚇親我喇！
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 dat6 jin4 kei5 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6 zan1 hai6 haak3 can1 ngo5 laa3

english.note: Use this when the surprise startles or frightens A, rather than pleasantly surprising them.

exampleSentences.english: You shouted loudly behind me and gave me a nasty surprise!
exampleSentences.traditional: 你突然喺我後面大嗌，嚇親我喇！
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 dat6 jin4 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6 daai6 ngaai3 haak3 can1 ngo5 laa3
